feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so I state no outcome for it. The best raced design so far is iteration 2 (score 713.62): the oval finishes 20/20 at 1.85 s, the s-bend 19/20 at 2.18 s, and the slalom 0/20, with progress 0.63, 1.05 line-loss events per run, and steering_oscillation 0.31. The slalom failure is line loss followed by drift, not jitter. Iteration 2's 16 mm sensors at +/-2 cm spread cannot see the 25 mm tape once the robot is more than about 2 cm off centre.

The candidate addresses that directly. It widens the sensor spread to x = -0.03, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.03 m, keeps the weights inside the contract limit of +/-2 (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), and rescales the gains so the per-cm response is unchanged: kp 1.5 to 2.25 and kd 0.6 to 0.9. Oval and s-bend should therefore stay close to iteration 2, and the change is isolated to the slalom line-loss mechanism. base_speed, mass, body, wheel track, sensor size and sensor y are unchanged, so the race will show the effect of the spread alone.

Read the next race this way. If slalom line_loss_events fall below 0.5 and slalom progress rises above 0.8, keep the spread and gains, and only then consider a small base_speed increase to recover completion time. If the slalom still goes off track with line_loss_events above 0.5, lower base_speed to 1.1 on the same geometry before changing gains again. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 on any track, the rescaled kd is too high for the new spread, so return kd toward 0.7 while keeping kp at 2.25.
requested_changes: If slalom line_loss_events remain above 0.5 or the slalom still goes off track: lower controller.base_speed from 1.2 to 1.1 with the widened spread, since iteration 2 showed the slalom losing the line at 1.2 and iteration 1 showed drop-outs at 1.3.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 on any track: lower controller.kd from 0.9 toward 0.7 and keep kp at 2.25, since iteration 2 oscillation was 0.25 to 0.33 and the rescaled kd could add jitter.

If the race finishes the slalom cleanly with completion_time under 2.8 s: keep the geometry and gains, and raise controller.base_speed in small steps (1.2 to 1.25) to recover time, since iteration 2 finish times were under 2.2 s on the s-bend.
